title: Run preparation
idea: Run preparation: Route difficulty and supply checklist lead a reviewable start
audience: People who need to prepare run within a game surface.
avoidWhen: Preparation interrupts a trivial repeated action
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its prepare run priority and explicit commitment contract: Starting a run commits only after valid configuration
navigation: Run preparation keeps the current prepare run context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Route difficulty and supply checklist lead a reviewable start
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to prepare run; players benefit from deliberate setup
composition.priority: Starting a run commits only after valid configuration

imagery.role: Support the actual prepare run context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep required loadout status visible with controller focus
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the run preparation structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no prepare run content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Starting a run commits only after valid configuration
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized prepare run content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Starting a run commits only after valid configuration
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active prepare run context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
